# Cavco’s Studio Collection Takes the Spotlight in MHInsider


Published On: November 11, 2026


•


1 min read


•


Cavco’s Studio Collection is getting a close look in MHInsider, the manufactured housing industry’s go-to publication. The feature, “[Inside Cavco’s Studio Collection: Designer Details Come Standard](https://mhinsider.com/cavco-studio-collection-designer-details/) ,” goes behind the scenes with Cavco’s Megan Foster, who led the team that designed the Studio Collection.


### The short version


The article starts with a question: what happens when Cavco’s interior designers, floor plan engineers and decorators get free rein to design a dream home? The answer is the Studio Collection, a national lineup of manufactured homes that packs designer features into an affordable price.


Megan Foster, Director of Cavco’s Design Innovation Team, explains the thinking. The goal wasn’t the cheapest home. It was the most valuable one for the people living in it. Every floor plan, finish and fixture had to earn its place.


The feature also covers:


- **What buyers are asking for.** Freestanding tubs, tile backsplashes and integrated entertainment centers, balanced so the look stays fresh without feeling trendy.
- **A home for multiple generations.** The new Grande Arbor’s double-suite plan, shown in prototype at the Innovative Housing Showcase 2026 in Washington, D.C.
- **Standard, not extra.** Because Cavco offers details that often cost more elsewhere.


The article notes that the collection has already climbed into Cavco’s top three best sellers.


### Read the full story


There’s plenty more in the original, including Foster’s take on texture, kitchens, porches and the research behind each design choice.[Read the full article on MHInsider](https://mhinsider.com/cavco-studio-collection-designer-details/) , then explore the homes at[cavcohomes.com/studio-collection](https://www.cavcohomes.com/studio-collection) .
